phoneticConvention: English approximation in the style of the Melunga deck (phe field): dway-boo-chee = 对不起, may gwahn-shee = 没关系, ching = 请. Syllables of one word are joined with hyphens, words are separated by spaces. Tones are not shown: see the pinyin (reading field) and the audio. Standard Mandarin, simplified characters.
reviewStatus: Written by rule from validated content; native English review recommended. Linguistic review required (tones, naturalness of phrasing).
title: Explaining and comparing
goal: Explain a reason, compare and express a preference.

model.note: 因为… 所以… often come as a pair; in speech 所以 alone is enough. In 下雨了 / 太贵了, 了 marks a change of situation (it started raining) or the exclamation 太…了.

model.note: 以前 (before) is enough to describe a past habit. The second half repeats the verb with 不…了: 了 marks the change of state — 'not anymore'. The verb must be repeated (现在不抽了, 现在不住在那里了); 现在不了 on its own is not possible.

variants.phon: ee-chyen woh choh-yen, shyen-dzeye boo choh luh.
variants.native: I used to smoke, now I don't anymore.
variants.reading: yǐqián wǒ chōuyān, xiànzài bù chōu le.

turns.phon: shr yoh-dyen ywen, boo-gwoh woh-mun yoh ee guh dah yahng-teye!
turns.native: It is a bit far, but we have a big balcony!

dialogues.practice: Listen to both roles, hide one role, answer, then swap one line for a variant of your own.

readiness: You can give reasons with 因为… 所以…, compare with 比 (and 没有 for 'not as… as'), argue a preference (更喜欢…，因为…), give an opinion (我觉得) and contrast before and now (以前… 现在…了), recognizing the change-of-state 了.
